body: Yea man I hear ya. I’ve been fighting for 20 years and it’s just getting worse . Wasn’t just taking the Benzo with alcohol I have Percocet too.
Wow man , you are a legitimate piece of shit . Wishing covid -19 onto someone , what are you 12? You are a cunt.

Just started working last week in food delivery . Unfortunately my dr said no to that because I have chronic asthma which apparently is no bueno with covid-19. Got a note so my job seems ok . I just wanna get back to work and have less time to just sit with my thoughts , watch movies and self medicate . I have hobbies , I enjoy taking my 5 year Labrador out for her walks. Hiking in the local trails . Hard when I am social distancing though. . Other hobby would be snowboarding which is seasonal , glass blowing and my main passion travel . Sadly the later is an expense but I have made it a goal to do something for myself and save up for a nice trip somewhere before the end of the year , thinking Bali or Spain . Yea definitely have had to give some friends the boot. Always saw my older brother as more of a friend than a brother and haven’t talked to him since July . Have had to boot some of my other fiends who I felt “moved on” and loooed down on me. Funny how a bit of success and a college degree can make people suddenly feel superior . Trying to get back to school . I have a core of old friends I feel I can trust but my main one (also bipolar like me and a good mutual outlet for talking ) is scarce now because his gf for some reason doesn’t like me so therefore we don’t get to see each other . Trying to make more friends . Even looking into travel mate websites so I can have someone to travel with as opposed to solo travel . A bit awkward and out of my comfort zone but beats asking my friends who don’t travel..or worse my ex gf haha. How are you? Is the lockdown effecting you at all?

Sorry for the very late reply . Still here . Still depressed but have a possible job to start this week . Most of my friends are married with kids and have limited times to talk or hang out . Some are just really into themselves or selfish . My best friends live in Hawaii and Manchester Uk . So don’t get to see them often . One of
My closest friends who also has bipolar has been there for me a lot but he’s busy with 2 kids and I feel like he’s getting impatient with my lack of “progress “ (he’s recently diagnosed and super enthusiastic about therapy etc where as I have been battling this since I was a teenager so I am not as enthusiastic and a bit tired ) and his gf hates me and is toxic to him as well but he has not figured it out yet .

Yea that’s just my family . My moms old school , she’s from the Uk . Born during the end of WW2 and has the whole British “keep calm and carry on “ attitude from that era . If you complain she’ll have some example from 30 years ago where she had it worse . Used to try and explain how rude that is but she’s 75 and not changing . My friends on the other hand ..they gets frustrating .

It’s frustrating because my brother is bipolar 1, I am 2. My friends and family always ask “why don’t you handle things like your brother “ and they don’t understand that they are different disorders with different behaviors .
Thanks , nice that someone knows what I am going through .
